title: An App Designer record save moves RDM by 1 (PSVERSION and PSLOCK) and SYS by 1; PSRECDEFN.VERSION is the new RDM
statement: Saving a record definition in Application Designer, new (Save As) or changed, bumps PSVERSION and PSLOCK OBJECTTYPENAME RDM by one and PSVERSION SYS by one, and writes PSRECDEFN.VERSION as the new RDM value. Observed for field reorder, key, search, edit, default, label, Record Properties, audit, timestamp, record type, In-Memory and Save As saves. A save can move other counters as well: PGM when a field is removed, SRM when the record's SQL rows are written. Rename and delete are separate findings; windows that held two saves (RDM +2) are not covered.
